plot: At sunset after market day a tiny lost car, Wren, arrives with three clues (red door, choo-choo, bread smell); Turbo's fire-station guess and Bertha's toy-shop trip (spotted by Pip from the raised Truth Press) both fail, while a far-off 'toot-toot-TOOT' everyone calls a goose keeps coming closer; Grumpy makes everyone go quiet and Wren recognises her mum's honk; all honk together, Mum arrives (they just moved to Bakery Lane); lesson: when you're lost, stay put and listen; then a golden wheel appears on the podium.

script.title: Can We Get Wren Home Before Dark? 🌅🚗 Lost Little Car
script.description: A tiny car named Wren rolls into Wheelburg, lost, with only three clues: a red door, a choo-choo and the smell of warm bread. Inspector Bolt and friends race the sunset to get her home, but the answer is a sound everyone ignored. When you're lost, stay put and listen! Inspector Bolt #9

set.place: Wheelburg square, end of market day sunset

beats.say: Help! Help! I'm lost! Can anybody find my home?
It was the end of market day. The sun was sinking low.
Whoa! A tiny car I've never seen before! Who are you?
I'm Wren. I followed a butterfly, and now everything looks different.
Don't worry, Wren! I'm small too. Small cars are brave!
Oh, sweetie! Where do you live? We'll drive you right there!
I don't know my street name. I only remember three things.
She was holding a little gift, wrapped in blue paper.
It's for my mum. She must be so worried about me.
Far, far away, something went toot-toot-TOOT.
Ha! Did you hear that? A silly honking goose!
Geese go honk. Not toot. But fine. Nobody listens to me.
Beep beep! Inspector Bolt rolled in, his brown hat tipped low.
I heard a call for help. Procedure says: I come.
This is Wren! She's lost, and she can't find her home!
Then we will find it together. Before the sun goes down.
Wren, tell me your three clues. Nice and slowly, please.
Clue one. My house has a big red door.
Clue two. Every morning, I hear a choo-choo.
Clue three. My street smells like warm bread.
Red door! I know it! The fire station! Follow me!
Turbo, wait. First we think. Then we drive.
No time to think! Back in a flash! Zoom!
And Turbo zoomed away, quicker than a hiccup.
Little one. Are you cold? Come stand by me. Engines are warm.
You're a tow truck. Are you a grumpy tow truck?
Very grumpy. But I always find lost cars. That's my job.
Zooom! Turbo was back already, a little out of breath.
The fire station has a red door. But nobody lives there!
Just three fire trucks. They said hello. And they were very shiny.
Shiny. Ugh. I'm glad I didn't go.
That's not my house. My mum isn't a fire truck.
Oh dear! Look at the sky! The sun is going down!
If we don't hurry, Wren's mum will worry all night long.
I have an idea! I need to be up high. Really high!
High? Hmm. The Truth Press goes up. Procedure... allows it.
For the first time ever, the Truth Press was a lookout tower.
Wheee! I'm so tall! I can see the whole town!
Pip, what do you see? Any red doors?
A red door! Next to the train tracks! By the round tower!
Train tracks? Choo-choo! That could be my house!
Leave it to Big Bertha! I know every road in town!
Big Bertha rumbled off toward the train tracks.
Mister Bolt, what if I never find my house?
Every lost car gets found. Detectives never stop looking.
And tow trucks never stop either. Even grumpy ones.
Far away, again: toot-toot-TOOT. A little closer this time.
There it is again. That is not a goose.
It's a goose with a cold! Ha ha ha!
Rumble, rumble! Bertha came back, huffing and puffing.
That red door was the toy shop! It's full of rocking horses!
And I tried to squeeze under the train bridge. Squish!
Bertha! Your roof is flat! You look like a sandwich!
Only a tiny bit of sun is left. Think, everyone, think!
Bread smell! Let's sniff every street in town! Sniff, sniff!
No, let's honk at every door! HONK! HONK!
No, let's draw a giant map! With crayons!
Everyone is shouting! I'm getting all mixed up!
Shh. Everybody. Quiet. Just listen.
And for the very first time ever, Wheelburg was completely quiet.
Toot-toot-TOOT! Very close now.
That's not a goose! That's my mum's honk!
Told you. Geese go honk. Mums go toot-toot-TOOT.
Of course! Your mum isn't at home. She's out looking for you!
Wren, answer her. Your loudest honk, please!
Toot-toot-toot! Oh no, it's too small! She'll never hear it!
Then we all help! Everyone, together! One, two, three!
TOOT-TOOT-TOOOOOT!
And around the corner rolled a big green truck.
Wren! My little Wren! I've been tooting all over town!
Mum! I followed a butterfly, and then I got lost!
You stayed in one place and found helpers. That was smart.
We just moved here. Our new house is on Bakery Lane!
Bakery Lane? Bread smell! I was so close to sniffing it!
Today's lesson. When you're lost, stay put and listen.
Thank you, Grumpy. You're the best listener in Wheelburg!
Don't tell anyone. I'm still grumpy.
And Wren and her mum tooted all the way home.
Who left the golden wheel? Find out next time in Wheelburg!

fr.title: Wren rentrera-t-elle avant la nuit ? 🌅🚗

Une petite voiture nommée Wren arrive perdue à Wheelburg avec seulement trois indices : une porte rouge, un tchou-tchou et une odeur de pain chaud.
